top_opportunities.title: GM is turning to AI to slash vehicle development time. What it means
top_opportunities.summary: GM plans to halve vehicle development time using AI, cutting costs and boosting quality across its global operations.
top_opportunities.evidence: The Detroit-based automaker aims to cut vehicle development timelines to two years—and it sees artificial intelligence as a key player in that mission.

top_opportunities.title: GM lifts cash-flow outlook, unveils $20 billion buyback after strong Q3
top_opportunities.summary: GM raises cash‑flow and earnings outlook, adds $20 bn buyback, indicating a strong global business outlook.
top_opportunities.evidence: GM raised its outlook for adjusted automotive free cash flow to between $11.5 billion and $12.5 billion and tightened its EPS-diluted-adjusted forecast to $12.75 to $13.75, signaling confidence in its earnings power as it balances capital returns with ongoing investments.

top_opportunities.title: GM promises smarter cars, faster updates, and autonomous dry-cleaning runs
top_opportunities.summary: GM unveils AI-driven tech push, faster development, powerful compute units and autonomous features to boost its global competitiveness.
top_opportunities.evidence: GM claims it will use AI to cut vehicle development times in half, introduce compute units up to 40 times more powerful than its current hardware, model next‑gen battery chemistries in record time, and bring eyes‑off autonomous driving to its top‑selling trucks and SUVs.

top_opportunities.title: GM aims to develop vehicles in as little as two years with AI, software push
top_opportunities.summary: GM unveils AI-driven, faster EV development plans, aiming to boost competitiveness and future growth globally.
top_opportunities.evidence: GM said it is developing a “new operating approach for vehicle development” that leans into enterprise AI and virtualization to increase speed.

top_opportunities.title: GM’s 'Eyes Off' Autonomous Era is Just Around the Corner
top_opportunities.summary: GM unveils eyes‑off highway driving system for 2028, boosting autonomous capabilities across SUVs and trucks.
top_opportunities.evidence: Scheduled to debut in 2028, the technology allows drivers to redirect their attention from the road during highway operation under specific conditions.

top_threats.title: EXCLUSIVE: GM cancels deal with new US rare-earth magnet plant, documents say
top_threats.summary: GM cancels key magnet supply deal, reflecting broader EV retreat and a $6 billion charge, hurting its global EV outlook.
top_threats.evidence: The termination follows GM’s broader retreat from EV investments, as the automaker scaled back its EV plans after federal incentives and tax breaks that supported the market disappeared and took a $6 billion charge in January 2026 to unwind some of those investments.

top_threats.title: GM class action claims Chevy Traverse, other 2025 models have faulty brakes
top_threats.summary: Class action claims GM sold vehicles with faulty brakes and failed to recall, likely harming its global reputation and finances.
top_threats.evidence: The plaintiffs allege that GM has not issued a safety recall or instructed its dealerships to repair the defect despite the reported issues.

top_threats.title: General Motors sold Smart Drive data, will pay New York millions, AG says
top_threats.summary: GM will pay over $12 million to New York and $220 million nationwide for illegally selling driver data, damaging its reputation.
top_threats.evidence: General Motors will pay more than $12 million to New York State following an investigation that found the company was illegally selling drivers' private data, the office of Attorney General Letitia James announced — and the sale of the data potentially impacted drivers' insurance rates.

top_threats.title: Ohio to Get $8 Million From General Motors for Sharing Data on Drivers
top_threats.summary: GM to pay $220 million settlement for illegal driver data sales, facing new privacy rules and reputational damage.
top_threats.evidence: Attorney General Dave Sunday joined a coalition of 36 attorneys general in reaching a $220 million settlement with General Motors regarding consumer data-sharing.

top_threats.title: An Electric Corvette Is Still Coming. GM Won’t Say When
top_threats.summary: GM's promised electric Corvette remains delayed, raising concerns about its EV rollout and performance brand strategy.
top_threats.evidence: When I went digging in 2025 asking Team Chevy where the electric Corvette was, I was met with dead air and then non-answer answers.

top_opportunities.title: GM plans $2 billion investment at Lansing plants
top_opportunities.summary: GM will invest $2 billion in its Lansing Grand River and Lansing Delta Township plants, boosting production and supporting jobs.
top_opportunities.evidence: GM plans $2 billion investment at Lansing plants

top_opportunities.evidence: GM’s shares were up more than 6% around noon Tuesday after the announcement.

top_opportunities.evidence: Following intense pressure from its own retail network, GM confirmed it will restructure a $500 million Department of Energy grant to prepare its Lansing Delta Township plant for future hybrid vehicle production.
